tools.name: people_search
tools.description: Search a global professional database in plain English (for example 'Heads of Marketing at Series B SaaS in New York') and get a sample of matching people plus the true total match count. Results are masked previews (a masked name, role, industry, company size and location) and each one carries an o

tools.name: reveal_profile
tools.description: Unlock ONE person from a people_search result. Pass the `token` from that result. Spends 1 credit and returns the full profile: real name, current title and company, location and LinkedIn URL. Set `include_email` to true to also look up their verified professional (work) email in the same call, whic

tools.name: find_people
tools.description: The list-building tool. Re-runs a plain-English people search and unlocks up to `count` full profiles in ONE atomic charge: 1 credit per newly unlocked person, and anyone you already own is free. Returns each person's real name, title, company, location, LinkedIn URL and an `id`. Emails are NOT fetc

tools.name: fetch_email
tools.description: Look up the verified professional (work) email for a person you have already unlocked with find_people (or reveal_profile). Pass their `id`. Spends 1 credit, refunded automatically if no email is found. The lookup is live: if it returns emailStatus 'searching', call fetch_email again with the same i

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Check whether an email address exists and is safe to send to, before it bounces. Returns a deliverability verdict (deliverable, undeliverable, or unknown) without sending anything. Spends 1 credit, refunded if no verdict can be reached.

tools.name: find_company_emails
tools.description: Given a company domain or name, return the contactable role-based email addresses discovered for that organization (such as contact@, sales@, support@), each with a confidence level. Use this for reaching a company inbox, not a specific named person (for a named person use find_people or find_linked

tools.name: reverse_email_lookup
tools.description: Turn a professional email address into the real person behind it and their LinkedIn profile. Best for work emails; free-mailbox addresses often have no public profile to match. Spends 13 credits (this is the single most expensive lookup), refunded automatically if no match is found.

tools.name: find_linkedin_profile
tools.description: Find the LinkedIn profile URL for a named person. Provide their first and last name; adding the company or domain sharply improves the match. Spends 2 credits, refunded if no confident match is found.

tools.name: lookup_linkedin_profile
tools.description: Turn a LinkedIn profile URL into clean structured data: name, current role and company, and location. Spends 2 credits, refunded if the profile cannot be retrieved.

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Turn a LinkedIn company URL into firmographic data: industry, size, location and website. Spends 1 credit, refunded if the company cannot be retrieved.

tools.name: company_search
tools.description: Search a global company database in plain English (for example 'Series B fintech companies in London with 50-200 employees') and get matching companies with industry, size, location and website. Searching companies is FREE and spends no credits.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Return the current credit balance for the API key making the request. Free and read-only. Use it before a large find_people call to confirm there are enough credits.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: people_search, find_people, fetch_email, verify_email · Private data: people_search, reveal_profile, find_company_emails, company_search, check_credits · Public sink: people_search, reveal_profile, find_people, fetch_email, verify_email, find_company_emails, reverse_email_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: people_search, find_people, fetch_email, verify_email · Private data: people_search, reveal_profile, find_company_emails, company_search, check_credits · Public sink: people_search, reveal_profile, find_people, fetch_email, verify_email, find_company_emails, reverse_email_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
